countries.Ethiopia: (Ethiopia OR Ethiopian OR Tigray OR Amhara)
countries.Sudan: (Sudan OR Sudanese OR Darfur OR Kordofan)
countries.Somalia: (Somalia OR Somali OR Mogadishu OR Puntland)

topic_queries.humanitarian_terms: (humanitarian OR refugee OR refugees OR displaced OR displacement OR hunger OR famine OR malnutrition OR drought OR flooding OR cholera)
topic_queries.security_terms: (military OR armed OR fighting OR clashes OR troops OR insurgency OR war OR attacks)

notes: Use matched country-mention articles as denominator for humanitarian-term and security-term shares.
Query families can overlap: humanitarian plus security are not mutually exclusive and must not be summed.
Sudan may capture South Sudan articles; Sudan/South Sudan disambiguation requires audit.
Terms are a text-search proxy for framing, not proof of substantive humanitarian attention.
Zero article matches, GDELT outages, invalid JSON or missing dates must not become zero attention.
Global norm covers GDELT-monitored news, not all world media.
This design does NOT identify underattention relative to humanitarian severity or prove deliberate neglect.
